title: Execute and Validate a Scoped Refinement Action

story.so_that: automated changes remain inside the owner's authorized boundary and cannot game required evaluations
story.i_want: each selected refinement action executed as a traceable candidate and validated against its approved intent and file scope

target_persona.role: Owner or maintainer of a skill

journey.before: A refinement action has been selected and, when it changes evaluation expectations, has received explicit human approval. The owner is ready to execute it.
journey.during: The owner triggers the refinement Activity execution and reviews the returned usage metrics and changed-file evidence.
journey.after: The owner receives either a scope-valid candidate with structured evidence, or a clear rejection with no refinement commit created.

capability_breakdown.core_action: Execute a selected refinement action as a traceable candidate and validate the resulting diff against the approved action and authorized file scope.
inputs: A selected and, if required, approved refinement action
Structured Activity usage and changed-file contracts
Diff produced by the candidate changes
state_changes: The candidate is marked as scope-valid or rejected
No refinement commit is created for rejected iterations

database: Refinement action and approval evidence records
external_services: Version control system for diff retrieval

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a selected and, if required, approved action, when the corresponding refinement Activity runs, then it returns structured usage metrics and a list of changed files.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a selected and, if required, approved action When the corresponding refinement Activity runs Then it returns structured usage metrics and a list of changed files
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Run refinement Activity and receive structured evidence

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given the refinement Activity completes, when its resulting diff is validated, then the workflow confirms the diff matches the approved action and stays within the authorized file scope.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the refinement Activity completes When its resulting diff is validated Then the workflow confirms the diff matches the approved action and stays within the authorized file scope

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given an agent changes a file outside the authorized scope, when candidate validation runs, then the iteration is rejected and no refinement commit is created.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given an agent changes a file outside the authorized scope When candidate validation runs Then the iteration is rejected and no refinement commit is created

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a refinement action would remove, skip, weaken, or rewrite a failing required test to improve its score, when candidate validation runs, then the change is rejected rather than accepted as a repair.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a refinement action would remove, skip, weaken, or rewrite a failing required test to improve its score When candidate validation runs Then the change is rejected rather than accepted as a repair

edge_cases.gherkin: Given a refinement Activity runs and produces no changed files When candidate validation runs Then the candidate is rejected as a no-op

edge_cases.criterion: Approval evidence is missing for an expectation-changing action
edge_cases.gherkin: Given a selected action changes evaluation expectations and no approval evidence exists When execution is attempted Then the workflow rejects the action before running it

edge_cases.criterion: Authorized file scope is empty or undefined
edge_cases.gherkin: Given no authorized file scope is configured for a candidate When validation runs Then the workflow rejects the candidate to avoid unbounded changes

edge_cases.criterion: Diff contains both approved-scope and out-of-scope changes
edge_cases.gherkin: Given a candidate diff changes files both inside and outside the authorized scope When validation runs Then the iteration is rejected

edge_cases.criterion: Required test is modified but the change is ambiguous
edge_cases.gherkin: Given a candidate diff touches a required test in an ambiguous way When test-weakening validation runs Then the workflow conservatively rejects the change

edge_cases.criterion: Activity runner or external VCS is unavailable
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the Activity runner or version control system is unavailable When the refinement Activity runs Then the workflow reports the failure and creates no candidate
Given two refinement candidates are validated concurrently for the same skill When the workflow runs Then each candidate is evaluated independently and results are not conflated
Given the refinement Activity returns usage metrics that do not match the structured contract When validation runs Then the workflow rejects the candidate and reports a contract violation

questions.question: What is the exact schema and required fields for the structured usage metrics?
How is the authorized file scope represented and enforced?
What is the precise definition of 'weakening' a required test?
How is approval evidence cryptographically tied to the selected action?
Should rejected candidates be persisted for audit, or discarded?

blocks: Evaluate and accept a scope-valid candidate
Commit or revert a refinement candidate
related: EDD-006 refinement execution and scope validation
Authorize file-scope rules for a skill

domain_knowledge: Required test definition and evaluation rules
technical_knowledge: Git diff parsing and change classification
stakeholder_questions: What fields must the structured usage metrics contain?
Who defines and maintains the authorized file scope?
How are edge cases of test weakening reviewed and escalated?
